decision_rule: If bf16_window is noninferior to FP32 at the 1-point margin on EVERY task, it stays the primary product baseline. Otherwise (FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE or a task not run) it is ineligible as the primary baseline: its speed stays visible and FP32 is the comparator for cost claims. LeapQuant gets a quality-qualified cost claim only if it is noninferior on every task.
